**QualityKits**

QualityKits is a powerful and easy-to-use plugin that allows you to add customizable kits to your server.

With the built-in Kit Room, you can create and manage kits directly in-game. Easily save, load, and delete kits at any time, giving you full control over your server’s kit system without needing complicated configuration files.

Whether you're running a PvP server, minigames, or a survival experience, QualityKits makes kit management simple, fast, and efficient.
